sections.title: Project Context
sections.body: Agent Control Room is an AI Development Control Tower for non-developer PMs. It converts product direction into roadmaps, tasks, and agent routing with human-in-the-loop approval gates.

sections.title: Completed Phases
sections.body:
- Phase 1-8: Core orchestration, routing, prompts, execution runner
- Phase 9 in progress: Roadmap-first UI refactor

sections.title: Remaining Work
sections.body:
- Context Pack and Obsidian memory workflows
- Vibe Kanban deeper integration
- Production hardening and monitoring

sections.title: Important Decisions
sections.body:
- Hermes is background-only, never auto-executed
- Vibe Kanban is execution workbench, not orchestration brain
- All execution requires human approval gates
- MVP uses local JSON storage, Supabase as upgrade path

examples.title: Failed Task Review: Context Pack Markdown Export
examples.description: Example review of a failed attempt at context pack rendering.

sections.title: Task
sections.body: Render Context Pack as user-friendly Markdown with proper heading hierarchy.

sections.title: Error Summary
sections.body: Rendered Markdown had improper heading levels (used H1 for all sections, should vary H2-H3).

sections.title: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: The packet section structure used a fixed heading level, not the section.level field. Template did not follow the existing design pattern in renderHermesPacketMarkdown().

sections.title: Recommendations
sections.body:
- Always use section.level from packet definition
- Test Markdown output for proper heading hierarchy
- Validate against Obsidian Markdown compatibility

examples.title: Background Research: Hermes Design Patterns
examples.description: Research on effective patterns for background worker systems.

sections.title: Research: Hermes Design Patterns
sections.body: Investigation of how to design safe background worker systems that don't execute automatically.

sections.title: Key Findings
sections.body:
- Separate packet generation (safe) from execution (gated)
- Use explicit language: 'generate', 'preview', 'copy' instead of 'run', 'execute'
- Store packets as static data, not active tasks
- Require manual review before any agent work
- UI should emphasize draft/preview state clearly

examples.title: Note: Hermes as Background Memory System
examples.description: Obsidian-compatible insight note on Hermes design principles.

sections.title: Hermes as Background Memory System
sections.body: Hermes is designed as a background worker for summaries, memory, monitoring, and context packing. It should never auto-execute. Instead, it generates task packets (drafts) that users review, modify, and manually submit to other agents. This keeps the human in control while reducing context loss.
